description_en: Deletes a cross-cluster OSS reference repository from an instance
description_zh: 删除实例跨集群OSS引用仓库
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch delete-snapshot-repo --instance-id es-cn-n6w1o1x0w001c0000 --repo-path es-cn-n6w1rux8i000w0000 --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteSnapshotRepo

parameters.help_en: The referenced instance ID. To obtain this parameter, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178513.html
parameters.help_zh: 引用实例ID。获取参数信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178513.html。
parameters.name: repo_path

parameters.help_en: A unique token used to ensure idempotence of the request. Generated by the client, this value must be unique across different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

Result.description_en:
The returned result. Valid values:

true: The reference repository is deleted.
false: The reference repository failed to be deleted
Result.description_zh:
返回结果：

true：引用仓库删除成功
false：引用仓库删除失败
